messages:
Anya: Heads-up — noticed a crypto propagation gap after last CMK rotation. A handful of tenant snapshots are still tagged with the old CMK and restore tests are failing. Filing here to coordinate.
Samir: Oof. Which tenants and when did rotation run? logs?
Anya: Rotated CMK yesterday 03:12 UTC. Affected tenants show snapshot uploads between 03:00–03:45 that have metadata `x-amz-meta-cmk-id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/OLD-KEY` even though rotation completed at 03:12. Restores throw KMS decrypt errors.
Samir: Can you paste the error snippet?
Anya: ```
ERROR: restore failed: decrypt error: InvalidCiphertextException: Key ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/OLD-KEY is not available for decryption
snap_id=tenant-42/2026-03-21-0308
```
encops-bot: :warning: Alert: snapshot-decrypt-failures spike (us-west-2) — 7 failures in last 30m. Runbook suggested: check CMK metadata + re-encrypt job.
Leo: Two quick hypotheses: (1) backup uploader service used old credentials that referenced pre-rotation key material; (2) RBAC change removed kms:ReEncrypt from uploader role so re-encrypt step skipped.
Samir: I rolled the uploader IAM policy yesterday to tighten grants, might have inadvertently removed `kms:ReEncrypt` from `backup-uploader-role`. Checking.
Samir: Confirmed: policy change at 03:05 UTC replaced broad kms:* with a least-priv policy that included `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:Encrypt` but not `kms:ReEncrypt`. That would explain snapshots created after 03:05 but before rotation completed. My bad.
Jin: We need audit trail for snapshots created in that window. CloudTrail note: search for PutObject events with `x-amz-meta-cmk-id`. Quick CT query: ```
fields @timestamp, eventName, requestParameters.bucketName, requestParameters.key, userIdentity.arn
| filter eventName = "PutObject" and requestParameters.headers.x-amz-meta-cmk-id like /OLD-KEY/
| sort @timestamp asc
```
Jin: That will list which principals used uploader role.
Anya: Immediate mitigation options: (A) run a one-off re-encrypt job that calls KMS ReEncrypt for each affected object; (B) temporarily restore broader kms:ReEncrypt for uploader role and re-run uploads; (C) block restores until we re-encrypt. I prefer (A) + policy fix.
Samir: I'll run (A). I'll invoke the re-encrypt worker from admin account to avoid RBAC cycles. Plan: enumerate objects with old CMK, ReEncrypt -> write new object metadata with NEW-KEY id, verify checksums, then update snapshot manifest. Throttle to 200 ops/s.
encops-bot: playbook `reencrypt-snapshots-v1` queued by Samir. ETA start in 10m. Will post progress.
Leo: Also add an immediate audit alert: if snapshot metadata CMK != currently-active-CMK and object age > 5m, send page. We didn't have that match alert on.
Jin: Agree. Also update snapshot creation path to persist `cmk_id` in our own DB row (not just S3 metadata) and emit a structured audit event `snapshot.created` with cmk_id. That makes queries + alerts easier.
Samir: Patch for RBAC: I'll add explicit `kms:ReEncrypt` for the backup-uploader role, constrained to the new key ARNs and only for the snapshot bucket resource. Will submit PR and fast-track hatchet release.
Anya: Postmortem notes to capture: timeline, root cause = RBAC rollback removed ReEncrypt permission during rotation window; blast radius = ~12 tenants; detection = restore CI failures + alert; mitigation = re-encrypt job + RBAC fix; follow-ups = audit event + metadata replication + unit tests for policy changes.
Jin: Quick CloudTrail snippet to map principal -> tenant: ```
fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.bucketName, requestParameters.key
| filter eventName = "PutObject" and requestParameters.headers.x-amz-meta-cmk-id like /OLD-KEY/
```
encops-bot: playbook `reencrypt-snapshots-v1` started by Samir at 2026-03-21T03:30:12Z. Progress: 0/58 objects re-encrypted.
Samir: Running now. I'll keep throttling and post status every 15m.
Anya: Who's owning postmortem? I can draft it and include timeline + action items.
Leo: I'll own the policy review + add pre-merge CI check that audits IAM diffs for kms actions removed.
Jin: I'll add the audit-event changes and the CloudTrail saved query.
Samir: Re-encrypt finished 58/58. Verified restores for a sample tenant. Pushing RBAC PR now.
encops-bot: playbook `reencrypt-snapshots-v1` completed at 2026-03-21T03:47:01Z. Summary: 58 objects re-encrypted, 0 failures.
Anya: Great—closing incident once PR merged and we have the CI guard. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Samir: PR merged, policy change live. Running a quick canary to ensure no more old-CMK writes.
encops-bot: canary report: 0 new old-CMK snapshot writes in last 10m.
Anya: OK closing thread. Follow-ups: Anya (postmortem draft), Leo (IAM CI), Jin (audit events), Samir (policy changelog).
